findings: Confirmed legacy migration loss: flat DesktopSettings JSON is accepted by PersistedDesktopState because all fields default and unknown fields ignored; settings become default true/true/Alt+Shift+S/true. load_desktop_state only attempts legacy parse after new-schema failure, so intended fallback unreachable for this valid legacy input. Direct legacy parse preserves false flags and Ctrl+K in control.

Narrowing v1 frontend-normalizer concern: backend DesktopSettings serialized fields are nonoptional booleans with serde defaults on input; normal getDesktopSettings produces complete values. Missing-field/string-false frontend observations are robustness cases, not proven normal backend outputs.

Persistence std::fs::write overwrites target directly, without temporary+rename/fsync/backup. Parse/read failure logs and defaults; setup subsequently persists default state. No failure injection/user settings modified.

update_desktop_settings changes shortcut registration and in-memory settings before persistence; persistence error returns Err without rollback. register_app_shortcut unregisters previous shortcut before new registration, so registration failure can lose old binding while cached active string persists. Static failure-path review only, actual OS registration unexecuted.

Window mode is updated before emit/layout/show operations; errors can leave partially transitioned mode/window/save behavior. Focus failure is explicitly logged after showing rather than causing error.

Quick/full state preservation uses same native window, remembers full layout before switching, disables plugin saves during quick mode, and restores saved full layout. These are source mechanisms, not GUI proof.

Layout sanitization enforces nonzero/minimum dimensions but does not clamp coordinates or maximum to available monitors. Restore fallback happens on API error, so accepted offscreen coordinates may remain invisible. Static hypothesis.
Hide requires successful state persistence before window.hide; close handler prevents close in background mode then logs hide errors. Persistence failure can leave requested close/hide unperformed.
K32EmptyWorkingSet runs on hide, ignored result; no memory/performance gain accepted. Whole module concerns desktop UX rather than content-duplicate algorithm.
limits: 20/268 pinned blobs reviewed; full repo and runtime incomplete.
No Windows/Tauri window, real settings, shortcut, tray, registry, shell or working-set operations executed.
Probe validates serde migration mechanism only, not whole app build/upstream suite. No production edits or benchmark. Native pHash/ASAN deferred.
